text:
samir: Kicking off a config-only deploy for batching/routing tweaks in the afternoon window (16:10-16:40 UTC). Canary plan: 1% -> 7% -> 30% -> 100%. Keep eyes on p95/p99 and kvcache_free_pct.

deploy-bot: DeployBot started canary 7912345678 for cfg-afternoon-slim. Stages scheduled: 1% (+5m) -> 7% (+12m) -> 30% (+20m) -> 100% (+30m). Smoke tests running.

olga: Changes summary: per-tenant max_batch 12->7, route timeout 1300ms->900ms, tenant concurrency floor enforced=1, geo weight: shift 3% us-east->eu-west.

kerri: Abort triggers: p95 >= 1.5x baseline sustained 2m OR any pod OOM OR kvcache_free_pct drop below 62%. Rollback command: `rbctl rollback cfg-afternoon-slim && deploybot pin-route --route=global --model=v3`.

deploy-bot: Canary at 1% (7912345690). Smoke: PASS 5/5. Metrics: p95 160ms (baseline 150), p99 420ms, kvcache_free_pct 85%. No OOMs.

samir: Proceed to 7%.

deploy-bot: Progressed to 7% (7912345710). Snapshot: p95 165ms, p99 430ms, kvcache_free_pct 82%. No aborts.

pagerduty-bot: Alerts muted for rollout window per ops playbook.

deploy-bot: Reached 30% (7912345722). Metrics: p95 170ms, p99 440ms (baseline p99 435ms), kvcache_free_pct 80%. No OOMs.

kerri: Holding until +6m to watch tails, then finish if stable.

deploy-bot: Canary complete 100% at 7912345732. Final metrics: p95 152ms, p99 410ms, kvcache_free_pct 83%. No aborts.

samir: Release notes updated with fallback policy: "auto-fallback to cpu-quant-v1 for tenant spikes." Post-deploy: monitor 2h, keep canary tag 24h, pinned rollback command above. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
